So this report provides an update in regards to the ongoing base rent renewal negotiations between the city administration and nutrient wonder hub,
as well as recommendations to suspend the lease overholding provision within the agreement until a future decision report is presented to city council of budget deliberations.
As outlined in the report, the existing 10 year lease agreement with the nutrient wonder hub requires base rent or negotiations every five years.
The nutrient run wonder hub's current base rent is $155,000 per year and is scheduled to increase to 164,900 based off revised building valuations completed by an independent assessor.
The nutrient wonder hub's current request is based rent of approximately $84,000 or a 50% reduction from the current lease agreement.

There are several options committee and council could consider in response to this request, which may include adjusting the terms of the existing lease, adjusting future grant funding or maintaining the current lease provisions.

All of these options would have varying financial implications, which could include property tax funding requirement and or the sufficiency of the CBCM reserve to carry out any necessary repairs and maintain the facility.
We'll be recommended to report it back during the delivery.
There are also other matters pertaining to the lease that are also being discussed with nutrient wonder hub regarding responsibilities for building insurance costs and some maintenance costs.

The administration nutrient wonder hub have agreed to continue to discuss possible resolution to these matters in the spirit of the original agreement, which will be included in the report brought forward to 2025 budget deliberations.
Finally, the current lease agreement includes an overholding provision, which stipulates rent shall be increased to 150% if based rent arrangements are not made within the required timeframe.
In appreciation of ongoing negotiations and future decision report, the administration is recommending suspending this provision until the future decision report is presented.

Despite many successes, the museum faces, or despite many successes, the museum faces significant financial challenges.

equities and alternative investment tools into the city's investment portfolio.
